correctness.rationale: Complete mixed-independent-set classification produces deletion and link; the link is a join with a truncated partition matroid. Standard uniform-matroid sphere-wedge theorem and matroid shellability yield exact integral homotopy and Euler ranks. A standalone all-face modular boundary calculation passed 41 configurations in characteristics two and three; these checks are corroboration only.

value.rationale: For a canonical dense bipartite graph under concentrated edge erosion, a sharp complete k>=4 homotopy-and-persistence phase diagram distinguishes the first effective fault at k-1 missing spokes from a final-spoke birth of a new sphere dimension. It covers all large shore sizes and thresholds, with integral primitivity, not an arbitrary finite slice or routine recitation of existing formulas. The graph-face decomposition and the homological transition give mathematically interpretable structure.
